- prd: Generate a Product Requirements Document (PRD) for a new feature. Use when planning a feature, starting a new project, or when asked to create a PRD. Triggers on: create a prd, write prd for, plan this feature, requirements for, spec out.
- ralph: Convert PRDs to prd.json format for the Ralph autonomous agent system. Use when you have an existing PRD and need to convert it to Ralph's JSON format. Triggers on: convert this prd, turn this into ralph format, create prd.json from this, ralph json.
- recap-do-dia: Lê tudo que foi feito hoje (sessões Claude Code, commits git, tasks Todoist) e gera o mix certo de conteúdo pra X — short posts diários + thread candidata pro banco semanal — escrevendo no Notion para copy-paste manual.
- deep-research: Deep research harness — fan-out web searches, fetch sources, adversarially verify claims, synthesize a cited report. - When the user wants a deep, multi-source, fact-checked research report on any topic. BEFORE invoking, check if the question is specific enough to research directly — if underspecified (e.g., "what car to buy" without budget/use-case/region), ask 2-3 clarifying questions to narrow scope. Then pass the refined question as args, weaving the answers in.
- frontend-design:frontend-design: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- verify: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by running the app and observing behavior. Use when asked to verify a PR, confirm a fix works, test a change manually, check that a feature works, or validate local changes before pushing.
- code-review: Review the current diff for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud). Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

1	-- MIA Behavioral Intelligence — SOTA learning pipeline

4	-- ============================================================
5	-- 1. gidape_events — stream behavioural (L1)
6	-- ============================================================
7	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gidape_events (
8	    id          uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
9	    user_id     uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
10	    session_id  text NOT NULL,
11	    event_type  text NOT NULL,   -- page_enter | page_exit | feature_use | search_query | mia_opened | mia_suggestion_acted | click | form_submit | error_seen
12	    page        text NOT NULL,   -- route pathname
13	    properties  jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
14	    -- derivado para filtragem rápida
15	    loja_id     int4,
16	    role        text,
17	    device_type text,            -- mobile | tablet | desktop
18	    created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
19	);
20	
21	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS gidape_events_user_id_idx    ON gidape_events(user_id, created_at DESC);
22	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS gidape_events_session_idx    ON gidape_events(session_id, created_at);
23	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS gidape_events_type_idx       ON gidape_events(event_type, created_at DESC);
24	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS gidape_events_page_idx       ON gidape_events(page, created_at DESC);
25	
26	ALTER TABLE gidape_events ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
27	CREATE POLICY "gidape_events_insert_own" ON gidape_events FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);
28	CREATE POLICY "gidape_events_select_own" ON gidape_events FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = user_id);

31	    USING (EXISTS (
32	        SELECT 1 FROM profiles WHERE id = auth.uid()
33	            AND role IN ('admin', 'master', 'administrator')
34	    ));

36	-- ============================================================

38	-- ============================================================

40	    id          uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
41	    user_id     uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

75	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mia_counterfactual_sessions (
76	    id              uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
77	    user_id         uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
78	    session_id      text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
79	    started_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
80	    ended_at        timestamptz,
81	    duration_ms     int8,
82	    pages_visited   text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
83	    page_count      int4 NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
84	    loops_detected  int4 NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
85	    mia_opened      bool NOT NULL DEFAULT false,   -- se true → sessão de controle, não counterfactual
86	    -- métricas de tarefa (estimadas via dwell_time)
87	    avg_dwell_ms    int8,
88	    total_clicks    int4 NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
89	);
90	
91	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS mia_cf_sessions_user_idx ON mia_counterfactual_sessions(user_id, started_at DESC);
92	
93	ALTER TABLE mia_counterfactual_sessions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
94	CREATE POLICY "mia_cf_own" ON mia_counterfactual_sessions FOR ALL USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
95	
96	-- ============================================================
97	-- 5. mia_distilled_patterns — output do distillation loop (Padrão 1)
98	-- ============================================================
99	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mia_distilled_patterns (
100	    id           uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
101	    scope        text NOT NULL,    -- 'global' | 'role:gerente' | 'user:<uuid>'
102	    category     text NOT NULL,    -- 'skill_update' | 'workflow_pattern' | 'language_pattern' | 'friction_insight'
103	    title        text NOT NULL,
104	    content      text NOT NULL,    -- texto injetável no prompt MIA
105	    evidence     jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',   -- métricas que suportam o pattern
106	    confidence   float4 NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.7,
107	    active       bool NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
108	    distilled_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
109	    expires_at   timestamptz,      -- null = permanente
110	    created_by   text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'mia-distillation'
111	);
112	
113	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS mia_distilled_active_idx ON mia_distilled_patterns(active, scope, distilled_at DESC);
114	
115	ALTER TABLE mia_distilled_patterns ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
116	-- só service_role escreve; usuários lêem apenas os de scope global/role
117	CREATE POLICY "mia_distilled_select" ON mia_distilled_patterns FOR SELECT USING (
118	    active = true AND (
119	        scope = 'global' OR
120	        scope LIKE 'role:%' OR
121	        scope = 'user:' || auth.uid()::text
122	    )
123	);
124	
125	-- ============================================================
126	-- 6. mia_proactive_queue — fila de notificações proativas (L4)
127	-- ============================================================
128	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mia_proactive_queue (
129	    id           uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
130	    user_id      uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
131	    type         text NOT NULL,    -- 'morning_digest' | 'anomaly' | 'pattern_insight' | 'loop_friction'
132	    title        text NOT NULL,
133	    body         text NOT NULL,
134	    context      jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
135	    priority     int4 NOT NULL DEFAULT 5,   -- 1=crítico, 10=informacional
136	    delivered    bool NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
137	    delivered_at timestamptz,
138	    created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
139	    expires_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now() + interval '24 hours')
140	);
141	
142	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS mia_proactive_user_idx ON mia_proactive_queue(user_id, delivered, created_at DESC);
143	
144	ALTER TABLE mia_proactive_queue ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
145	CREATE POLICY "mia_proactive_own" ON mia_proactive_queue FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
146	
147	-- ============================================================
148	-- 7. Extensão de mia_user_patterns (novas colunas comportamentais)
149	-- ============================================================
150	DO $$ BEGIN
151	    -- top_pages: rotas mais acessadas com frequência
152	    IF NOT EXISTS (
153	        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
154	        WHERE table_name = 'mia_user_patterns' AND column_name = 'top_pages'
155	    ) THEN
156	        ALTER TABLE mia_user_patterns ADD COLUMN top_pages jsonb DEFAULT '[]';
157	    END IF;
158	
159	    -- top_flows: sequências de navegação mais comuns (array de arrays)
160	    IF NOT EXISTS (
161	        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
162	        WHERE table_name = 'mia_user_patterns' AND column_name = 'top_flows'
163	    ) THEN
164	        ALTER TABLE mia_user_patterns ADD COLUMN top_flows jsonb DEFAULT '[]';
165	    END IF;
166	
167	    -- peak_hours: {hour: count} — quando o usuário é mais ativo
168	    IF NOT EXISTS (
169	        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
170	        WHERE table_name = 'mia_user_patterns' AND column_name = 'peak_hours'
171	    ) THEN
172	        ALTER TABLE mia_user_patterns ADD COLUMN peak_hours jsonb DEFAULT '{}';
173	    END IF;
174	
175	    -- avg_dwell_ms por página: {route: avg_ms}
176	    IF NOT EXISTS (
177	        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
178	        WHERE table_name = 'mia_user_patterns' AND column_name = 'avg_dwell_ms'
179	    ) THEN
180	        ALTER TABLE mia_user_patterns ADD COLUMN avg_dwell_ms jsonb DEFAULT '{}';
181	    END IF;
182	
183	    -- feature_usage_map: {feature_id: count}
184	    IF NOT EXISTS (
185	        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
186	        WHERE table_name = 'mia_user_patterns' AND column_name = 'feature_usage_map'
187	    ) THEN
188	        ALTER TABLE mia_user_patterns ADD COLUMN feature_usage_map jsonb DEFAULT '{}';
189	    END IF;
190	
191	    -- loop_count: total de loops de fricção detectados
192	    IF NOT EXISTS (
193	        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
194	        WHERE table_name = 'mia_user_patterns' AND column_name = 'loop_count'
195	    ) THEN
196	        ALTER TABLE mia_user_patterns ADD COLUMN loop_count int4 DEFAULT 0;
197	    END IF;
198	
199	    -- last_loop_detected_at
200	    IF NOT EXISTS (
201	        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
202	        WHERE table_name = 'mia_user_patterns' AND column_name = 'last_loop_detected_at'
203	    ) THEN
204	        ALTER TABLE mia_user_patterns ADD COLUMN last_loop_detected_at timestamptz;
205	    END IF;
206	
207	    -- mia_suggestion_act_rate: taxa de aceitação de sugestões da MIA (0.0–1.0)
208	    IF NOT EXISTS (
209	        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
210	        WHERE table_name = 'mia_user_patterns' AND column_name = 'mia_suggestion_act_rate'
211	    ) THEN
212	        ALTER TABLE mia_user_patterns ADD COLUMN mia_suggestion_act_rate float4 DEFAULT 0;
213	    END IF;
214	
215	    -- counterfactual_avg_dwell_ms: tempo médio em páginas SEM MIA (baseline)
216	    IF NOT EXISTS (
217	        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
218	        WHERE table_name = 'mia_user_patterns' AND column_name = 'counterfactual_avg_dwell_ms'
219	    ) THEN
220	        ALTER TABLE mia_user_patterns ADD COLUMN counterfactual_avg_dwell_ms int8;
221	    END IF;
222	
223	    -- behavioral_updated_at: última vez que o perfil comportamental foi recalculado
224	    IF NOT EXISTS (
225	        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
226	        WHERE table_name = 'mia_user_patterns' AND column_name = 'behavioral_updated_at'
227	    ) THEN
228	        ALTER TABLE mia_user_patterns ADD COLUMN behavioral_updated_at timestamptz;
229	    END IF;
230	END $$;
231	
232	-- ============================================================
233	-- 8. Trigger: atualiza perfil comportamental em tempo real
234	--    após cada insert em gidape_events
235	-- ============================================================
236	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_update_behavioral_profile()
237	RETURNS TRIGGER LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
238	DECLARE
239	    v_hour int4;
240	    v_peak jsonb;
241	    v_feat jsonb;
242	    v_feat_id text;
243	    v_feat_count int4;
244	    v_pages jsonb;
245	    v_page_entry jsonb;
246	    v_page_found bool := false;
247	    v_dwell_ms int8;
248	    v_page text;
249	    v_from text;
250	    v_to text;
251	BEGIN
252	    v_hour := EXTRACT(HOUR FROM NEW.created_at)::int4;
253	    v_page := NEW.page;
254	
255	    -- Garante linha em mia_user_patterns
256	    INSERT INTO mia_user_patterns(user_id)
257	        VALUES(NEW.user_id)
258	        ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING;
259	
260	    -- Atualiza peak_hours
261	    SELECT COALESCE(peak_hours, '{}') INTO v_peak FROM mia_user_patterns WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id;
262	    v_peak := jsonb_set(v_peak, ARRAY[v_hour::text], to_jsonb(COALESCE((v_peak ->> v_hour::text)::int4, 0) + 1));
263	
264	    -- Contabiliza feature_use
265	    IF NEW.event_type = 'feature_use' THEN
266	        v_feat_id := NEW.properties->>'feature_id';
267	        IF v_feat_id IS NOT NULL THEN
268	            SELECT COALESCE(feature_usage_map, '{}') INTO v_feat FROM mia_user_patterns WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id;
269	            v_feat_count := COALESCE((v_feat ->> v_feat_id)::int4, 0) + 1;
270	            v_feat := jsonb_set(v_feat, ARRAY[v_feat_id], to_jsonb(v_feat_count));
271	            UPDATE mia_user_patterns
272	                SET feature_usage_map = v_feat,
273	                    peak_hours = v_peak,
274	                    behavioral_updated_at = now()
275	                WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id;
276	            RETURN NEW;
277	        END IF;
278	    END IF;
279	
280	    -- page_exit: atualiza avg_dwell_ms por página e nav_graph
281	    IF NEW.event_type = 'page_exit' THEN
282	        v_dwell_ms := (NEW.properties->>'dwell_ms')::int8;
283	        v_from := v_page;
284	        v_to := NEW.properties->>'next_page';
285	
286	        -- Atualiza avg_dwell_ms no perfil
287	        IF v_dwell_ms IS NOT NULL AND v_dwell_ms > 0 THEN
288	            DECLARE
289	                v_dwell_map jsonb;
290	                v_old_avg int8;
291	                v_old_count int4;
292	                v_new_avg int8;
293	            BEGIN
294	                SELECT COALESCE(avg_dwell_ms, '{}') INTO v_dwell_map FROM mia_user_patterns WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id;
295	                v_old_avg := COALESCE((v_dwell_map -> v_page ->> 'avg')::int8, 0);
296	                v_old_count := COALESCE((v_dwell_map -> v_page ->> 'count')::int4, 0);
297	                v_new_avg := ((v_old_avg * v_old_count) + v_dwell_ms) / (v_old_count + 1);
298	                v_dwell_map := jsonb_set(
299	                    v_dwell_map,
300	                    ARRAY[v_page],
301	                    jsonb_build_object('avg', v_new_avg, 'count', v_old_count + 1)
302	                );
303	                UPDATE mia_user_patterns
304	                    SET avg_dwell_ms = v_dwell_map, peak_hours = v_peak, behavioral_updated_at = now()
305	                    WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id;
306	            END;
307	        END IF;
308	
309	        -- Atualiza nav_graph (from → to)
310	        IF v_from IS NOT NULL AND v_to IS NOT NULL AND v_from != v_to THEN
311	            INSERT INTO user_nav_graph(user_id, from_page, to_page, weight, last_seen_at)
312	                VALUES(NEW.user_id, v_from, v_to, 1, now())
313	                ON CONFLICT (user_id, from_page, to_page)
314	                DO UPDATE SET weight = user_nav_graph.weight + 1, last_seen_at = now();
315	        END IF;
316	
317	        RETURN NEW;
318	    END IF;
319	
320	    -- mia_suggestion_acted: atualiza taxa de aceitação
321	    IF NEW.event_type = 'mia_suggestion_acted' THEN
322	        UPDATE mia_user_patterns
323	            SET mia_suggestion_act_rate = (
324	                -- média móvel exponencial simples (α=0.2)
325	                COALESCE(mia_suggestion_act_rate, 0) * 0.8 +
326	                CASE WHEN (NEW.properties->>'acted')::bool THEN 0.2 ELSE 0 END
327	            ),
328	            peak_hours = v_peak,
329	            behavioral_updated_at = now()
330	            WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id;
331	        RETURN NEW;
332	    END IF;
333	
334	    -- Atualiza top_pages
335	    IF NEW.event_type = 'page_enter' THEN
336	        SELECT COALESCE(top_pages, '[]') INTO v_pages FROM mia_user_patterns WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id;
337	
338	        -- Procura página existente no array e incrementa count
339	        SELECT
340	            (SELECT jsonb_agg(
341	                CASE WHEN elem->>'page' = v_page
342	                    THEN jsonb_set(elem, '{count}', to_jsonb((elem->>'count')::int4 + 1))
343	                    ELSE elem END
344	            ) FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_pages) elem),
345	            EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_pages) elem WHERE elem->>'page' = v_page)
346	        INTO v_pages, v_page_found;
347	
348	        IF NOT v_page_found THEN
349	            v_pages := v_pages || jsonb_build_object('page', v_page, 'count', 1);
350	        END IF;
351	
352	        -- Mantém top-20 por count
353	        SELECT jsonb_agg(elem ORDER BY (elem->>'count')::int4 DESC)
354	            FROM (SELECT elem FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_pages) elem LIMIT 20) sub
355	            INTO v_pages;
356	
357	        UPDATE mia_user_patterns
358	            SET top_pages = COALESCE(v_pages, '[]'),
359	                peak_hours = v_peak,
360	                behavioral_updated_at = now()
361	            WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id;
362	        RETURN NEW;
363	    END IF;
364	
365	    -- Fallback: só atualiza peak_hours
366	    UPDATE mia_user_patterns
367	        SET peak_hours = v_peak, behavioral_updated_at = now()
368	        WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id;
369	
370	    RETURN NEW;
371	END;
372	$$;
373	
374	DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_gidape_events_update_profile ON gidape_events;
375	CREATE TRIGGER trg_gidape_events_update_profile
376	    AFTER INSERT ON gidape_events
377	    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_update_behavioral_profile();
378	
379	-- ============================================================
380	-- 9. View: behavioral profile rico para MIA consumir
381	-- ============================================================
382	CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_user_behavioral_profile AS
383	SELECT
384	    p.user_id,
385	    p.total_queries,
386	    p.preferred_format,
387	    p.verbosity_pref,
388	    p.expertise_level,
389	    p.top_tools,
390	    p.top_intents,
391	    p.top_modules,
392	    p.top_pages,
393	    p.top_flows,
394	    p.peak_hours,
